name: Campingdorf Hofer
beschreibung: Campingdorf Hofer is located on the southern outskirts of Zell am Ziller in the Zillertal. The site stretches along the Ziller, an alpine river. The surrounding area is characterized by the mountain ranges of the Kitzbüheler und Zillertaler Alpen. Hiking and cycling trails begin directly at the site. In winter, the ski areas of the Zillertal Arena can be reached via a free ski bus. The campsite offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents. Amenities include sanitary facilities, a bread roll service and a small shop. From here, guests can take excursions into the surrounding mountain world.
